dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: I saw that new movie everyone is talking about last night. Have you seen it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not yet. I read a review that said the plot was a bit predictable.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Honestly, the first half is, but the ending completely surprised me.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Interesting. What did you think of the lead performance?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Outstanding. The actress made her character feel real and complex.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: And the director? I loved his previous work.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: He keeps his usual style, with long shots and very little dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That can be beautiful, or boring, depending on the story.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Here it works, especially because of the soundtrack. It adds so much emotion.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Would you say the movie is worth watching in the movie theater?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Definitely. The images and the sound need a big screen.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then I will go this weekend, even though critics disagree.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Critics and audiences rarely agree, so make up your own mind.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: True. Which would you rate higher, this movie or his last one?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: His last one, but only slightly. I would give this one four stars out of five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good to know. Let us discuss it again after I have seen it.
